meta.note: Story models for the Model Generator (29 Oct 2026). Each story is fixed and coherent; only the target language rotates: suspense words, time expressions, feeling phrases, endings. Short and focused, as Michael asked: kids rarely read whole stories.

stories.label: The postman
stories.given: When he saw the postman coming up to his door, Matt ran to open it.
stories.before: He had been waiting for the letter for weeks.
stories.background: Outside, rain was falling softly and the street was still asleep.

tension.t: a gust of wind blew the letters across the street.
one of them had his name on it.

ending.t: the letter was from his best friend in Canada.
they spoke for hours on the phone.

look: It was a day he would never forget.
He still keeps that letter in his drawer.

stories.label: The final
stories.given: Lucy had never been so nervous before a match.
stories.before: She had been training for this final all season.
stories.background: The crowd was shouting and the rain was beating down on the pitch.

tension.t: the referee pointed to the penalty spot.
Lucy walked slowly towards the ball.
the goalkeeper dived the wrong way.

ending.t: the ball hit the back of the net.

look: It was a moment she would never forget.
From that day on, she never doubted herself again.

stories.label: The premiere
stories.given: The lights went out just as the film was about to start.
stories.before: Leo had been looking forward to this premiere for months.
stories.background: Everyone was whispering and nobody was moving.

tension.t: a strange noise came from behind the screen.
Leo crept nervously towards the exit.

ending.t: the lights came back on and the film began.

look: It was a night he would never forget.
He has never been to a premiere since.

stories.label: The last bus
stories.given: It was the last bus of the night, and Emma had just missed it.
stories.before: She had stayed at the party far too long.
stories.background: The street was getting dark and a cold wind was blowing.

tension.t: a car stopped right beside her.

ending.t: he offered to drive her home.

look: From that day on, she never missed the last bus again.
It was a lesson she would never forget.

stories.label: The box
stories.given: Sam knew he should not have opened the box.
stories.before: His grandfather had kept it locked in the attic for years.
stories.background: Dust was dancing in the light and the old house was silent.

tension.t: he heard footsteps on the stairs.
Sam quickly hid the box under the bed.

ending.t: the box was full of old photos of Sam as a baby.
they looked at them together for hours.

look: It was an afternoon he would never forget.
From that day on, he never kept a secret from his grandfather again.

stories.label: The first day
stories.given: On her first day at the new school, Mia did not know anyone.
stories.before: Her family had moved to the city only a week before.
stories.background: Everyone was chatting loudly and nobody was looking at her.

tension.t: Mia walked shyly to the front of the class.

ending.t: it was her birthday, and the class had found out.
she had made three new friends.

close: By the end of the day,
look: It was a day she would never forget.
From that day on, she never felt alone at school.
